description: This file implements a deduplication allocator for a YAML processing library. It manages deduplication tags and entries, handles setup and cleanup, memory allocation and deallocation, and tracks statistical information for deduplicated data buffers. It includes functions for store, release, trimming, resetting, and info retrieval related to the deduplication process.

methods.name: int fy_dedup_setup(struct fy_allocator * a,const void * cfg_data)
methods.description: Initializes the deduplication allocator with configuration parameters, preparing internal structures and sub-allocators.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_cleanup(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the deduplication allocator and its tags.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator * fy_dedup_create(const void * cfg)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new deduplication allocator instance based on provided configuration.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_destroy(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Destroys a deduplication allocator instance, freeing resources.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_dump(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Outputs internal state and statistics of the deduplication allocator for debugging.

methods.name: void * fy_dedup_alloc(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Allocates memory via the deduplication allocator using a specific tag and size, potentially shared if identical data exists.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_free(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,void * data)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a specific deduplication entry or raw data.

methods.name: int fy_dedup_update_stats(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,struct fy_allocator_stats * stats)
methods.description: Updates allocation statistics for a specific dedup tag.

methods.name: const void * fy_dedup_storev(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const struct iovec * iov,int iovcnt,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores data (via scatter-gather list) with deduplication, returning a pointer to unique data buffer.

methods.name: const void * fy_dedup_store(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores contiguous data with deduplication, delegating to storev.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_release(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Decreases reference count of stored data, freeing resources if no longer used.

methods.name: int fy_dedup_get_tag(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Allocates and sets up a new deduplication tag, returning its identifier.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_release_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Releases a deduplication tag, cleaning associated resources.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_trim_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Performs trimming operations on a deduplication tag.

methods.name: void fy_dedup_reset_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Resets a deduplication tag to initial state.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator_info * fy_dedup_get_info(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Retrieves information about the allocator state and memory usage for a specific tag.
